title: 序章 这究竟是什么鬼地方？
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
方正睁开眼睛，两眼无神的望着眼前的星空。
这是………什么地方？
他转过头去，望向两旁，看见的却只有破烂的木板，耳边还能够听到轮子吱呀吱呀的响声以及急促的马蹄声。
“呜…………”
头部传来的刺痛让方正不由的呻吟了一声，他闭上眼睛，开始仔细回忆自己之前所发生的一切，如果方正没有记错的话，之前他还在外面，然后………
“少爷！少爷你醒了吗？”
就在方正苦苦思索的时候，忽然，一个老人从旁边出现，那是一个须发皆白的老人，他穿着一件破破烂烂的皮甲，背后还背着一把长剑。这幅打扮是如此的古怪，以至于让方正都有些愣神。不过更让他觉得奇怪的是，对方说的是自己完全没有听过的语言，但是不知道为什么，此刻的方正却感觉自己似乎完全能够听懂这个老人在说什么。
但是即便如此，方正内心的疑惑依旧没有消除。
他是谁？为什么要叫我少爷？我………又是谁？
“呜………啊！！”
就在方正打算仔细回忆的时候，忽然，他感觉自己的大脑传来了仿佛针刺一般的疼痛，这让方正不由的双手抱头，痛呼起来。而看见此刻的方正，老人更是慌张不已。他急忙来到方正的面前，用力按住他的肩膀。
“少爷，你怎么样了？！不要吓我啊！”
“我………我…………”
耳边听到老人焦急的大喊声，方正却是什么都说不出来，此刻的他头疼欲裂，眼前的景色都开始变得扭曲起来。但是很快，方正就看见一道蓝色的光辉在自己的面前展开，形成了一个看起来非常熟悉而独特的界面。紧接着，一个轻柔的声音在他耳边响起。
“界面激活完毕………系统开始启动………检测到灵魂波长………开始认证………”
“呜………啊………”
此刻的方正已经感觉到不仅仅是头在疼，甚至连他的身体都好像被放在了屠宰场上正在抽筋扒皮般的痛苦。血液正在逆流，呼吸都变得急促起来，心脏激烈的跳动着仿佛要从喉咙里奔出来一般。而方正此刻唯一能够做的，就是本能的握紧拳头，死死咬住牙关忍耐着这忽然降临的一切。
“卡特大人！那些人追上来了！”
“该死！你们快点儿带着少爷离开，我们留下来………！”
“小心———！！”

“轰！！”
耳边隐隐约约可以听到外面嘈杂与尖叫的声音，但是还没有等方正反应过来发生了什么事，他就听到身边忽然传来了一声剧烈的爆炸声响，下一刻方正就感觉自己失去了平衡，仿佛一个被人抛弃的皮球般从马车之中飞出，重重的摔倒在地面上。
“噗啊！！”
方正可以感觉到自己的后背重重的撞在大地上，那猛烈的冲击甚至略微驱散了那足以燃烧自己身体的痛苦。也正因为如此，他这才勉强取回了自己身体的控制权，而方正就这样转过头去，望向四周。
此刻举目所见的，只有一片笼罩在黑暗之中的荒野，在他的身边，一辆马车正在火焰中熊熊燃烧，而负责拉车的马也被烧成了焦炭。在不远处，方正还能够隐隐约约的看见几个正在战斗的身影，他们看起来好像是一群侍从，而他们的敌人，则身穿着银白色的盔甲，仿佛游戏之中的骑士一般。
这究竟是什么鬼地方？
虽然那些战士看起来很努力，但是就连方正都能够看出，他们完全不是对方的对手，只是几个来回的功夫，那些战士就被穿着白银盔甲的骑士们无情的斩杀在剑下，化为了一具具尸体。
“少爷！快走！快点儿离开这里！！”
此刻唯有那个老人还在挥舞长剑，苦苦支撑，同时大声的朝着方正呼喊着。
知道现在，方正都不清楚自己遇到了什么，可是他很清楚，自己现在最好还是离开这里！
但………他的身体，却完全无法如方正所愿的行动，不知道为什么，此刻的他只感觉自己肌肉酸痛无比，浑身上下没有一丝的力气，光是支撑起身体就已经是耗尽全力，就连想要站起来都变成了一种奢望。
“灵魂波长认证成功，绑定完毕，请执行者激活法典。”
耳边那个声音依旧不紧不慢，而伴随着这个声音，方正看见自己眼前那个奇怪的界面中间浮现出了一个奇怪而复杂的圆圈，那看起来像是一个法阵，不过要按照方正的经验来看，这个界面似乎异常的熟悉………

content_en:
Fang Zheng opened his eyes and stared blankly at the starry sky in front of him.
What is this place?
He turned his head and looked to both sides, but all he saw were broken wooden boards, and he could still hear the squeaking of wheels and the rapid sound of horse hooves.
"Woo..."
The stinging pain in his head made Fang Zheng groan involuntarily. He closed his eyes and began to carefully recall everything that had happened before. If Fang Zheng remembered correctly, he was still outside before, and then...
"Master! Master, are you awake?"
While Fang Zheng was thinking hard, suddenly, an old man appeared from the side. He was an old man with white beard and hair. He was wearing a tattered leather armor and carrying a long sword on his back. This outfit was so weird that it even made Fang Zheng a little stunned. But what made him feel even more strange was that the other person spoke a language that he had never heard of before, but for some reason, Fang Zheng felt at this moment that he could completely understand what the old man was saying.
But even so, Fang Zheng's inner doubts were still not eliminated.
who is he? Why do you call me Master? Who am I?
"Ugh...ah!!"
Just when Fang Zheng was about to recall it carefully, he suddenly felt a pain like a needle in his brain. This made Fang Zheng couldn't help but hold his head with both hands and cry out in pain. Seeing Fang Zheng at this moment, the old man was even more panicked. He hurriedly came to Fang Zheng and pressed his shoulders hard.
"Master, how are you?! Don't scare me!"
"I...I..."
He heard the old man's anxious shouting, but Fang Zheng couldn't say anything. At this moment, he had a splitting headache and the scenery in front of him began to become distorted. But soon, Fang Zheng saw a blue light unfolding in front of him, forming an interface that looked very familiar and unique. Then, a soft voice sounded in his ear.
"Interface activation completed...the system starts to start...soul wavelength detected...authentication starts..."
"Ugh...ah..."
At this moment, Fang Zheng already felt that not only was his head hurting, but his body was also in pain as if it had been put on a slaughterhouse and was being cramped and skinned. The blood was flowing backwards, breathing became rapid, and the heart was beating fiercely as if it was about to rush out of the throat. The only thing Fang Zheng could do at this moment was to clenched his fists instinctively, gritted his teeth and endured everything that suddenly happened.
"Lord Carter! Those people are catching up!"
"Damn it! You take the young master and leave quickly, we stay...!"
"Be careful————!!"
"Boom!!"
In his ears, he could vaguely hear the noise and screaming outside, but before Fang Zheng could react to what happened, he heard a sudden violent explosion beside him. The next moment, Fang Zheng felt that he had lost his balance and flew out of the carriage like a discarded ball, falling heavily to the ground.
"Pfft!!"
Fang Zheng could feel his back hitting the ground hard, and the violent impact even slightly dissipated the pain that was enough to burn his body. Because of this, he barely regained control of his body, and Fang Zheng just turned his head and looked around.
All he could see at this moment was a wilderness shrouded in darkness. Beside him, a carriage was burning in flames, and the horse responsible for pulling the carriage was also burned to charcoal. Not far away, Fang Zheng could vaguely see several figures fighting. They looked like a group of attendants, and their enemies were wearing silver-white armor, like knights in the game.
What the hell is this place?
Although those soldiers seemed to be working hard,But even Fang Zheng could see that they were no match for each other. In just a few back and forth efforts, those warriors were mercilessly killed by the knights in silver armor and turned into corpses.
"Master! Go quickly! Get out of here quickly!!"
At this moment, only the old man was still waving the long sword, struggling to hold on, and at the same time shouting loudly towards Fang Zheng.
Now, Fang Zheng doesn't even know what he has encountered, but he knows very well that it is best for him to leave here now!
But...his body was completely unable to move as Fang Zheng wanted. For some reason, at this moment, he only felt that his muscles were extremely sore, and he had no strength at all. Just supporting his body was already exhausting all his strength, and even wanting to stand up became a luxury.
"The soul wavelength authentication is successful and the binding is completed. Please activate the code by the executor."
The voice in his ear was still unhurried, and along with this voice, Fang Zheng saw a strange and complicated circle emerging in the middle of the strange interface in front of him. It looked like a magic circle, but judging from Fang Zheng's experience, this interface seemed unusually familiar...
